name: Yoseph Ayele
description: Yoseph is Founder & Managing Partner at LAVA, a firm that invests in founders building new financial infrastructures across Africa, researches new primitives of money, and grows builder ecosystems. He co-created Borderless Africa and magma, bringing Africa's leading founders and the Ethereum ecosystem together. He previously co-founded the Edmund Hillary Fellowship, which persuaded New Zealand to create a new visa and let a non-profit pick who came through it.
